# Top mutated genes, WGS cohort (nonsilent, PCGR tumor VAF >= 3% and >= 5%)

Input is the variant-level audit table written by the WGS frequency script
(coding-class MAF rows already matched to PCGR VAF). Oncogenicity, HGVSp and
HGVSc are added from the PCGR Excel files by an exact sample + variant key.

```{r paths_and_parameters}
# ============================================================
# Paths and parameters
# ============================================================

top_dir       <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification/Top_Mutated_Genes_Cohort"
pcgr_dir      <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/pcgr_outputs"
clinical_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation/pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv"

run_date <- "2026-09-29"   # date stamp of the WGS frequency run

audit_file <- file.path(
  top_dir,
  paste0("Full_MAF_nonsilent_variant_PCGR_VAF_match_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")
)

freq_file_for <- function(pct) {
  file.path(top_dir, sprintf(
    "Full_MAF_nonsilent_VAFge%dpct_gene_mutation_frequency_%s.tsv", as.integer(pct), run_date))
}

VAF_THRESHOLDS <- c(0.03, 0.05)   # fractions
TOP_N_VALUES   <- c(50, 100)
DROP_SAMPLES_WITHOUT_VARIANT <- TRUE   # FALSE = keep all samples as columns
SAVE_PNG <- TRUE

input_files <- c(
  audit_file = audit_file,
  clinical_file = clinical_file,
  freq3 = freq_file_for(3),
  freq5 = freq_file_for(5)
)
missing_inputs <- names(input_files)[!file.exists(input_files)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop("Input file(s) not found:\n",
       paste0(missing_inputs, ": ", input_files[missing_inputs], collapse = "\n"))
}
```

```{r colors}
# ============================================================
# Colors
# ============================================================

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

binary_receptor_cols <- c(
  "Negative" = "#1F78B4",
  "Positive" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown"  = "#BDBDBD"
)

base_mutation_colors <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation"       = "#1F77B4",
  "Nonsense_Mutation"       = "#D62728",
  "Frame_Shift_Del"         = "#9467BD",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins"         = "#8C564B",
  "In_Frame_Del"            = "#2CA02C",
  "In_Frame_Ins"            = "#17BECF",
  "Splice_Site"             = "#FF7F0E",
  "Splice_Region"           = "#FFBB78",
  "Translation_Start_Site"  = "#E377C2",
  "Nonstop_Mutation"        = "#BCBD22",
  "Multi_Hit"               = "#000000"
)

get_mutation_colors <- function(types) {
  types <- unique(types)
  types <- types[!is.na(types) & types != ""]

  known <- intersect(types, names(base_mutation_colors))
  missing <- setdiff(types, names(base_mutation_colors))

  cols <- base_mutation_colors[known]

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_cols) <- missing
    cols <- c(cols, extra_cols)
  }

  cols[types]
}
```

```{r helper_functions}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions (WGS versions of sample-ID and key functions)
# ============================================================

clean_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  toupper(x)
}

# Removes the "JC287-" prefix so WGS IDs can match the clinical file
# (JC287-TP08-525 -> TP08-525) and strips a trailing _T / -T / .T.
clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("^JC287-", "", x)
  sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
}

# Order by TP number, then by the numeric part (525 < 1447; M509 -> 509)
natural_sample_order <- function(samples) {
  samples <- unique(as.character(samples))
  key <- sub("^JC287-", "", samples)
  tp  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^TP([0-9]+).*", "\\1", key)))
  tp[is.na(tp)] <- 9999L
  rest    <- sub("^TP[0-9]+[-_]*", "", key)
  restnum <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", rest)))
  restnum[is.na(restnum)] <- 9999L
  samples[order(tp, restnum, samples)]
}

clean_hgv <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  x <- sub(".*:", "", x)
  toupper(x)
}

normalize_oncogenicity <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("[ -]+", "_", x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[x == "ONCOGENIC"] <- "Oncogenic"
  out[x == "LIKELY_ONCOGENIC"] <- "Likely_Oncogenic"
  out
}

safe_file_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_

  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)
  val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x)))
  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2
  val
}

clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[grepl("^Positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"
  out
}

clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- x
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"
  out
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant key: chr:pos:ref:alt. MAF insertions with REF="-" use the
# left-flank coordinate (inserted sequence starts at Start_Position + 1).
# Identical PREFIX is removed first (shifts the position), then the suffix.
# This reproduces the MAF representation of VCF-style indels.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) || !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) || !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (maf_format && ref == "-") pos <- pos + 1L
  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) && substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) == substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) return(NA_character_)

  paste(chr, pos, ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"), ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"), sep = ":")
}

# PCGR GENOMIC_CHANGE (e.g. "16:g.68808447AGAATT>A") -> same key style
pcgr_genomic_key <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(NA_character_)

  hit <- regmatches(
    x,
    regexec("^(?:chr)?([^:]+):g\\.([0-9]+)([ACGTN]+|-)>([ACGTN]+|-)$",
            x, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )[[1]]

  if (length(hit) == 5L) return(edit_key(hit[2], hit[3], hit[4], hit[5]))
  NA_character_
}
```

```{r read_clinical}
# ============================================================
# Clinical file
# ============================================================

cat("Reading clinical annotation file:\n", clinical_file, "\n\n")

clinical_dt <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  sep = ",",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A")
)

clinical_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Sample)]
clinical_dt[, tumor_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`)]
clinical_dt[, pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(
  `pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`
)]
clinical_dt[, TILs_pct := parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`)]
clinical_dt[, Grade_clean := clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`)]
clinical_dt[, HER2_status := clean_receptor_status(`BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc`)]
clinical_dt[, ER_status := clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #1 (ER)`)]
clinical_dt[, PR_status := clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #2 (PR)`)]

clinical_plot_dt <- unique(
  clinical_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Sample_key,
      tumor_cellularity_pct,
      pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
      TILs_pct,
      Grade_clean,
      HER2_status,
      ER_status,
      PR_status
    )
  ],
  by = "Sample_key"
)

cat("Clinical samples:", nrow(clinical_plot_dt), "\n\n")
```

```{r define_plot_function}
# ============================================================
# Main plotting function (same style and annotation as the WES script).
# Reads these globals, which are set per threshold in the loop below:
#   maf_dt, all_samples, VAF_TAG, VAF_LABEL, out_dir, table_dir
# ============================================================

make_category_oncoplot <- function(category_name, genes) {

  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Gene set:", category_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes_key <- clean_key(genes)

  cat_maf <- maf_dt[Gene_key %in% genes_key]

  if (nrow(cat_maf) == 0) {
    cat("No mutated genes from this gene set found in MAF. Skipping.\n\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  plot_samples <- all_samples

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cell-level summary (Multi_Hit = >1 variant in same Sample + Gene)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cell_dt <- cat_maf[
    ,
    {
      onc_vals <- ONCOGENICITY[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

      cell_onc <- ""
      if ("Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
        cell_onc <- "Oncogenic"
      } else if ("Likely_Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
        cell_onc <- "Likely_Oncogenic"
      }

      list(
        n_variants = .N,
        Display = ifelse(.N > 1, "Multi_Hit", as.character(Variant_Classification[1])),
        Variant_Classification_List = paste(unique(Variant_Classification), collapse = ";"),
        HGVSp_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp)), collapse = ";"),
        HGVSc_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSc)), collapse = ";"),
        VAF_percent_List = paste(unique(na.omit(VAF_percent)), collapse = ";"),
        Cell_ONCOGENICITY = cell_onc,
        ONCOGENICITY_List = paste(unique(na.omit(ONCOGENICITY)), collapse = ";"),
        ONCOGENICITY_match_methods = paste(unique(na.omit(oncogenicity_match_method)), collapse = ";")
      )
    },
    by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol, Gene_key)
  ]

  # Order genes: altered samples, then variant rows, then rank order passed in
  gene_order_dt <- cell_dt[
    ,
    .(
      n_altered_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
      n_variant_rows = sum(n_variants),
      category_order = match(Gene_key[1], genes_key)
    ),
    by = .(Gene_key, Hugo_Symbol)
  ]

  setorder(gene_order_dt, -n_altered_samples, -n_variant_rows, category_order, Hugo_Symbol)

  plot_genes <- gene_order_dt$Hugo_Symbol
  names(plot_genes) <- NULL

  category_safe <- safe_file_name(category_name)

  fwrite(
    cell_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation matrix and oncogenicity matrix
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mut_mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(plot_genes), ncol = length(plot_samples),
                    dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples))
  onc_mat <- matrix("", nrow = length(plot_genes), ncol = length(plot_samples),
                    dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples))

  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(cell_dt))) {
    g <- cell_dt$Hugo_Symbol[ii]
    s <- cell_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[ii]

    if (g %in% rownames(mut_mat) && s %in% colnames(mut_mat)) {
      mut_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Display[ii]
      onc_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Cell_ONCOGENICITY[ii]
    }
  }

  plot_mat <- mut_mat
  plot_mat[plot_mat == ""] <- NA_character_

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Top stacked barplot: mutation rows per sample
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_class_dt <- cat_maf[, .N, by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification)]

  sample_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
    sample_class_dt,
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode ~ Variant_Classification,
    value.var = "N",
    fill = 0
  )

  sample_class_mat_dt <- merge(
    data.table(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples),
    sample_class_mat_dt,
    by = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  sample_class_mat_dt <- sample_class_mat_dt[match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]

  sample_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_class_mat_dt), "Tumor_Sample_Barcode")

  if (length(sample_class_cols) == 0) {
    sample_class_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(plot_samples), ncol = 1,
                               dimnames = list(plot_samples, "No_mutation"))
  } else {
    for (cc in sample_class_cols) {
      sample_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
    }
    sample_class_mat <- as.matrix(sample_class_mat_dt[, ..sample_class_cols])
    rownames(sample_class_mat) <- sample_class_mat_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bottom clinical annotations
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  plot_sample_keys <- clean_sample(plot_samples)

  sample_clin_dt <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples,
    Sample_key = plot_sample_keys
  )

  sample_clin_dt <- merge(
    sample_clin_dt,
    clinical_plot_dt,
    by = "Sample_key",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  sample_clin_dt <- sample_clin_dt[match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
  sample_clin_dt[, Column_Index := seq_len(.N)]

  setcolorder(
    sample_clin_dt,
    c("Column_Index", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_key",
      setdiff(colnames(sample_clin_dt),
              c("Column_Index", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_key")))
  )

  fwrite(
    sample_clin_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")),
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
  )

  clinical_anno_df <- data.frame(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = sample_clin_dt$tumor_cellularity_pct,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = sample_clin_dt$pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
    `TILs (%)` = sample_clin_dt$TILs_pct,
    Grade = sample_clin_dt$Grade_clean,
    HER2 = sample_clin_dt$HER2_status,
    ER = sample_clin_dt$ER_status,
    PR = sample_clin_dt$PR_status,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  rownames(clinical_anno_df) <- plot_samples

  observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(clinical_anno_df$Grade))
  observed_grade_levels <- observed_grade_levels[observed_grade_levels != ""]
  missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))

  grade_cols_local <- grade_cols
  if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0) {
    extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
    grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_grade_cols)
  }

  clinical_anno_cols <- list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")),
    `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 30, 100), c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")),
    Grade = grade_cols_local,
    HER2 = binary_receptor_cols,
    ER = binary_receptor_cols,
    PR = binary_receptor_cols
  )

  bottom_clin_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    ` ` = anno_empty(height = unit(1, "mm"), border = FALSE),
    df = clinical_anno_df,
    col = clinical_anno_cols,
    na_col = "grey90",
    which = "column",
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_rot = 0,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.30, "cm"),
    gap = unit(c(3.5, rep(1.1, ncol(clinical_anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = c(
      ` ` = FALSE,
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE,
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE,
      `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
      Grade = TRUE,
      HER2 = TRUE,
      ER = TRUE,
      PR = TRUE
    ),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
      `TILs (%)` = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
      Grade = list(title = "Grade"),
      HER2 = list(title = "HER2"),
      ER = list(title = "ER"),
      PR = list(title = "PR")
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Right-side stacked barplot: altered samples per gene by class
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gene_class_dt <- cell_dt[, .N, by = .(Hugo_Symbol, Display)]

  gene_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
    gene_class_dt,
    Hugo_Symbol ~ Display,
    value.var = "N",
    fill = 0
  )

  gene_class_mat_dt <- merge(
    data.table(Hugo_Symbol = plot_genes),
    gene_class_mat_dt,
    by = "Hugo_Symbol",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  gene_class_mat_dt <- gene_class_mat_dt[match(plot_genes, Hugo_Symbol)]

  gene_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(gene_class_mat_dt), "Hugo_Symbol")

  if (length(gene_class_cols) == 0) {
    gene_class_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = length(plot_genes), ncol = 1,
                             dimnames = list(plot_genes, "No_mutation"))
  } else {
    for (cc in gene_class_cols) {
      gene_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
    }
    gene_class_mat <- as.matrix(gene_class_mat_dt[, ..gene_class_cols])
    rownames(gene_class_mat) <- gene_class_mat_dt$Hugo_Symbol
  }

  gene_mutated_sample_counts <- rowSums(mut_mat != "")
  gene_mutated_sample_pct <- round(100 * gene_mutated_sample_counts / ncol(mut_mat))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation colors
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mut_types_heatmap <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.vector(plot_mat))))
  sample_bar_classes <- colnames(sample_class_mat)
  row_bar_classes <- colnames(gene_class_mat)

  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- sort(unique(c(
    mut_types_heatmap, sample_bar_classes, row_bar_classes
  )))
  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- setdiff(all_mutation_types_for_plot, "No_mutation")

  mutation_colors <- get_mutation_colors(all_mutation_types_for_plot)

  sample_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[sample_bar_classes]
  sample_bar_colors[is.na(sample_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  row_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[row_bar_classes]
  row_bar_colors[is.na(row_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  top_bar_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    `Mutations per sample` = anno_barplot(
      sample_class_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = sample_bar_colors, col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.97,
      height = unit(2.2, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )

  right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
    `Altered samples by class` = anno_barplot(
      gene_class_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = row_bar_colors, col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.90,
      axis = TRUE,
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), side = "bottom")
    ),
    `% altered` = anno_text(
      paste0(gene_mutated_sample_pct, "%"),
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
      just = "left",
      location = 0
    ),
    width = unit(4.2, "cm"),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Square cell size and page size
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cell_size_mm <- 4.0

  heatmap_body_width_mm <- max(55, cell_size_mm * ncol(mut_mat))
  heatmap_body_height_mm <- max(38, cell_size_mm * nrow(mut_mat))

  plot_width <- max(13, min(26, heatmap_body_width_mm / 25.4 + 9.5))
  plot_height <- max(8, min(24, heatmap_body_height_mm / 25.4 + 5.5))

  onc_lgd <- Legend(
    title = "PCGR oncogenicity",
    type = "points",
    labels = c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    pch = c(8, 24),
    size = unit(c(2.0, 2.0), "mm"),
    legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = "black")
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Oncoplot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  ht <- Heatmap(
    plot_mat,
    name = "Mutation type",
    col = mutation_colors,
    na_col = "grey80",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_order = plot_genes,
    column_order = plot_samples,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_title = paste0(
      category_name,
      " | genes: ", nrow(mut_mat),
      " | samples: ", ncol(mut_mat),
      " | ", VAF_LABEL
    ),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm, "mm"),
    rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
    top_annotation = top_bar_ha,
    bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,
    right_annotation = right_bar_ha,
    column_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
    row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Mutation type",
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    ),
    layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

      grid.rect(
        x = x, y = y,
        width = width * 0.995, height = height * 0.995,
        gp = gpar(fill = "grey80", col = "white", lwd = 0.10)
      )

      for (kk in seq_along(x)) {
        this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]

        if (!is.na(this_mut) && this_mut != "") {
          grid.rect(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk],
            width = width[kk] * 0.96, height = height[kk] * 0.96,
            gp = gpar(fill = mutation_colors[this_mut], col = NA)
          )
        }
      }

      for (kk in seq_along(x)) {
        this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]
        this_onc <- onc_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]

        symbol_col <- "black"
        if (!is.na(this_mut) && this_mut == "Multi_Hit") symbol_col <- "white"

        if (!is.na(this_onc) && this_onc == "Oncogenic") {
          grid.points(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk], pch = 8, size = unit(1.8, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )
        } else if (!is.na(this_onc) && this_onc == "Likely_Oncogenic") {
          grid.points(
            x = x[kk], y = y[kk], pch = 24, size = unit(1.8, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PDF and PNG
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pdf_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot_PCGR_oncogenicity_", VAF_TAG, ".pdf"))
  png_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot_PCGR_oncogenicity_", VAF_TAG, ".png"))

  pdf(pdf_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)
  draw(ht,
       heatmap_legend_side = "right",
       annotation_legend_side = "right",
       heatmap_legend_list = list(onc_lgd),
       merge_legends = FALSE,
       padding = unit(c(4, 28, 6, 4), "mm"))
  dev.off()

  if (isTRUE(SAVE_PNG)) {
    png(filename = png_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, units = "in", res = 300)
    draw(ht,
         heatmap_legend_side = "right",
         annotation_legend_side = "right",
         heatmap_legend_list = list(onc_lgd),
         merge_legends = FALSE,
         padding = unit(c(4, 28, 6, 4), "mm"))
    dev.off()
  } else {
    png_file <- NA_character_
  }

  cat("Saved:\n")
  cat("  ", pdf_file, "\n")
  if (!is.na(png_file)) cat("  ", png_file, "\n")
  cat("\n")

  summary_dt <- data.table(
    Gene_set = category_name,
    Genes_requested = length(genes),
    Mutated_genes_plotted = nrow(mut_mat),
    Samples_shown = ncol(mut_mat),
    Cells_with_mutation = sum(mut_mat != ""),
    Cells_with_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Oncogenic"),
    Cells_with_Likely_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    Mutation_filter = paste0("nonsilent, PCGR ", VAF_LABEL),
    PDF = pdf_file,
    PNG = png_file
  )

  graphics.off()
  gc()

  return(summary_dt)
}
```

```{r read_variants_and_oncogenicity}
# ============================================================
# 1. Variant table from the WGS audit
# ============================================================

audit <- fread(audit_file, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"))

need <- c("Sample_key", "Hugo_Symbol", "Variant_Classification", "Chromosome",
          "Start_Position", "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
          "VAF_TUMOR_fraction", "matched", "is_nonsilent")
if (length(setdiff(need, names(audit)))) {
  stop("Audit file lacks columns: ", paste(setdiff(need, names(audit)), collapse = ", "))
}

audit[, matched      := as.logical(matched)]
audit[, is_nonsilent := as.logical(is_nonsilent)]

audit[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key, Chromosome, Start_Position, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE), USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]
audit[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Variant_key, sep = "|")]
audit[, Tumor_Sample_Barcode := Sample_key]   # folder ID = barcode

sample_ids <- natural_sample_order(unique(audit$Sample_key))
cat("Samples in audit:", length(sample_ids), "\n")
print(sample_ids)

# ============================================================
# 2. Oncogenicity, HGVSp, HGVSc from the PCGR Excel files
# ============================================================

pcgr_anno <- rbindlist(lapply(sample_ids, function(s) {
  f <- file.path(pcgr_dir, s, paste0(s, ".pcgr.grch38.xlsx"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    warning("PCGR workbook not found: ", f)
    return(NULL)
  }
  dt <- as.data.table(read_excel(f, sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL", guess_max = 100000))
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(NULL)

  data.table(
    Sample_key   = s,
    Variant_key  = vapply(dt$GENOMIC_CHANGE, pcgr_genomic_key, character(1)),
    ONCOGENICITY = normalize_oncogenicity(dt$ONCOGENICITY),
    HGVSp        = as.character(dt$HGVSp),
    HGVSc        = as.character(dt$HGVSc)
  )
}))

pcgr_anno[, Match_key := paste(Sample_key, Variant_key, sep = "|")]

# If one key has several PCGR rows, keep the strongest oncogenicity call
pcgr_anno[, onc_rank := 0L]
pcgr_anno[ONCOGENICITY %in% "Likely_Oncogenic", onc_rank := 1L]
pcgr_anno[ONCOGENICITY %in% "Oncogenic",        onc_rank := 2L]

pcgr_best <- pcgr_anno[!is.na(Variant_key)][order(-onc_rank), .(
  ONCOGENICITY = ONCOGENICITY[1],
  HGVSp = HGVSp[1],
  HGVSc = HGVSc[1]
), by = Match_key]

audit <- merge(audit, pcgr_best, by = "Match_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
audit[, oncogenicity_match_method := fifelse(!is.na(ONCOGENICITY), "Sample+VariantKey", NA_character_)]

cat("\nCoding variants with a PCGR oncogenicity call:\n")
print(audit[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY), .N, by = ONCOGENICITY])
```

```{r run_thresholds}
# ============================================================
# 3. Loop over VAF thresholds (3% and 5%)
# ============================================================

all_summaries <- list()

for (MIN_VAF in VAF_THRESHOLDS) {

  MIN_VAF_PERCENT <- as.integer(round(100 * MIN_VAF))
  VAF_TAG   <- paste0("VAFge", MIN_VAF_PERCENT, "pct")
  VAF_LABEL <- paste0("VAF \u2265", MIN_VAF_PERCENT, "%")

  out_dir   <- file.path(top_dir, paste0(VAF_TAG, "_variant_filtered"))
  table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
  dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat("\n\n############################################################\n")
  cat("Threshold:", VAF_LABEL, "\n")
  cat("############################################################\n")

  # Same retention rule as the frequency table
  maf_dt <- audit[
    is_nonsilent == TRUE & matched == TRUE &
      !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction) & VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF &
      !is.na(Hugo_Symbol)
  ]
  maf_dt[, VAF_percent := round(100 * VAF_TUMOR_fraction, 2)]
  maf_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(Hugo_Symbol)]
  maf_dt[, maf_row_id := .I]

  cat("Mutations retained for plotting:", nrow(maf_dt), "\n")

  # Samples shown / dropped
  samples_with_variant <- natural_sample_order(unique(maf_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode))
  dropped <- setdiff(sample_ids, samples_with_variant)

  if (length(dropped)) {
    cat("Samples dropped (no non-silent variant with ", VAF_LABEL, "):\n", sep = "")
    print(dropped)
  } else {
    cat("No samples dropped.\n")
  }

  fwrite(
    data.table(
      Sample = dropped,
      Reason = rep(paste0("no non-silent variant with ", VAF_LABEL), length(dropped))
    ),
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("dropped_samples_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t"
  )

  all_samples <- if (DROP_SAMPLES_WITHOUT_VARIANT) samples_with_variant else sample_ids
  cat("Samples shown:", length(all_samples), "of", length(sample_ids), "\n")

  # Clinical match check
  clin_hit <- clean_sample(all_samples) %in% clinical_plot_dt$Sample_key
  cat("Samples matched to clinical file:", sum(clin_hit), "of", length(all_samples), "\n")
  if (any(!clin_hit)) {
    cat("Not matched to clinical file:\n")
    print(all_samples[!clin_hit])
  }

  # Rank genes cohort-wide
  gene_summary <- maf_dt[
    , .(n_altered_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode), n_variant_rows = .N),
    by = .(Gene_key, Hugo_Symbol)
  ]
  setorder(gene_summary, -n_altered_samples, -n_variant_rows, Hugo_Symbol)
  gene_summary[, Rank := .I]

  fwrite(gene_summary,
         file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohort_gene_ranking_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

  top_gene_sets <- setNames(
    lapply(TOP_N_VALUES, function(n) head(gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol, n)),
    paste0("Top", TOP_N_VALUES, "_Genes_Cohort")
  )

  # Concordance with the frequency table
  freq_dt <- fread(freq_file_for(MIN_VAF_PERCENT), sep = "\t")
  freq_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(Hugo_Symbol)]

  chk <- merge(
    gene_summary[Rank <= max(TOP_N_VALUES), .(Gene_key, this_script = n_altered_samples)],
    freq_dt[, .(Gene_key, frequency_table = Mutated_Samples)],
    by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE
  )
  chk[, Agree := this_script == frequency_table]

  fwrite(chk,
         file.path(table_dir, paste0("concordance_with_frequency_table_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
         sep = "\t")

  cat("Genes disagreeing with frequency table:", chk[Agree == FALSE | is.na(Agree), .N], "\n\n")

  # Draw oncoplots
  for (gs in names(top_gene_sets)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      make_category_oncoplot(category_name = gs, genes = top_gene_sets[[gs]]),
      error = function(e) {
        message("[ERROR] ", gs, " (", VAF_TAG, "): ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      res[, VAF_threshold := VAF_LABEL]
      all_summaries[[length(all_summaries) + 1]] <- res
    }
    graphics.off()
    gc()
  }
}

if (length(all_summaries) > 0) {
  summary_dt <- rbindlist(all_summaries, fill = TRUE)

  fwrite(summary_dt,
         file.path(top_dir, paste0("oncoplot_summary_all_thresholds_", run_date, ".tsv")),
         sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

  print(summary_dt[, .(VAF_threshold, Gene_set, Mutated_genes_plotted, Samples_shown,
                       Cells_with_mutation, Cells_with_Oncogenic_symbol,
                       Cells_with_Likely_Oncogenic_symbol)])
}

writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()),
           file.path(top_dir, paste0("sessionInfo_top_genes_WGS_", run_date, ".txt")))

cat("\nAll done. Plots are saved in:\n", top_dir, "\n")
```
